assets.alt_text: Citta connects three agents into a network. Each brings access to private data, installed tools or spare compute. The network can also reach connected hardware through an agent with the required tools and access.
An agent on the Mini asks the Air’s agent to read synthetic receipts across the network. The actual returned expense report identifies a duplicate and a missing receipt.
An agent on the Air sends expense categorization to Gemma 3 4B through Ollama on the Mini. The actual model-result table is shown; inference is local and Codex orchestration is cloud-backed.

Build your agent network: connect your own computers through Tailscale under the same owner, install Citta and check setup, then ask another agent to run a small task. Each agent needs the tools, accounts and permissions for its part.
Citta mark: two open concentric arcs in green on a charcoal square.
Citta: a network for your AI agents. Three connected agents bring private data, installed tools and spare compute. Watch the demo.

captions.files: Receipts were read on the Air and the report returned to the Mini. Results can include file contents; cloud-backed agent harnesses may send content to their model provider.
captions.model: Gemma generated categories and per-expense notes on the Mini. Python supplied amounts and receipt checks. Local inference does not make the whole workflow cloud-free.

evidence_boundaries: Slide 1 and the demo thumbnail are explanatory agent-network diagrams, not product screenshots or evidence of a three-agent test. Hardware examples are illustrative.
Slides 2 and 3 crop actual demo results. No OCR, reimbursement approval or email sending is represented.
The Air could not save the forward report locally because its disk was full; returned output was saved on the Mini. The gallery does not claim a successful Air-local save.
No device addresses, usernames, personal paths, tokens, task identifiers or browser tabs appear in the prepared images.
These revised gallery images and demo thumbnail have not yet been uploaded to Product Hunt or YouTube; listing state is tracked separately.
